title: Laparoscopic Assisted Pull-through Versus Other Surgical Procedures for Treatment of Hirschsprung Disease
brief_summary: To evaluate the outcomes of laparoscopic pull-through concerning constipation, incontinence and enterocolitis in comparison of other surgical procedures for treatment of Hirschsprung disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age from 6months to 3 years.
2. Both sexes.
3. Classic and long segment Hirshsprung.
4. Total a ganglionic colon.
5. Hirshsprung disease with leveling colostomy

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients \<6 months and \>3 years.
2. Short and Ultra-short Hirshsprung.
3. Recurrent cases of Hirshsprung.
4. Other contraindication of laparoscopy
